messages.subject: Regarding average of all value
parts:
Dear all,
I surveyed marine dolphins during my PhD work.  Study was carried out for two seasons i.e. winter and summer for two year. so i got total 4 different results and all are showing different density and estimates. my question is that should i average this all four results as one density and estimate? i am using Distance 7.3 software.
Thanking you

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Regarding average of all value
parts:
Yash

Your question "combine data from four surveys to produce a single estimate" does not have a purely statistical answer.  Survey design and data analysis needs to be guided by the question posed by the researcher.  The research question of interest will guide you in how to approach your analysis.

Eric Rexstad
